scope: Technical source-orchestration amendment for the same 6674/2324 conditional cash-share-conversion qualification; no new event population, parameter search or total-request budget extension.
amendment_reason: The prior protocol allowed one remaining source batch. An attachment pointer may first become visible after its original notice has been archived and read back. Retain the completed two-request index phase unchanged; allow dependent, separately frozen followup batches inside the same remaining six requests.
actual_observation_rule: Record actual acquisition/reconciliation timestamps, including observations on2026-10-22; no claim that these were available or sealed at the earlier query end.
retired_branch: The unused adaptive branch of configs/cash_merger_current_protocol_20261021.json is retired by this new protocol. Keep all its bytes, freezes and saved index sources immutable. Do not run workers in that old phase concurrently with this phase or spend requests through both branches.
release_rule: Parent pins the completed current-index checkpoint and every member before freezing this new protocol. A null index checkpoint or absent/mismatched protocol freeze blocks acquisition; no user approval is needed for this save/restore step.

source_ledger.meaning: Two saved index requests, including transport outcomes, are reconciled to the verified old archive before using the new six-request ceiling. Every failed new request consumes budget. New adaptive batches share this same six-request allocation.

transport: native_public_sources.py; verified HTTPS; two workers; shared phase source lock; parent serializes old/new phases
dependent_batch_rule: At least one request per batch and at most six new requests in total. The initial three-notice batch leaves at most three one-request followup batches. Freeze every exact dependent request and its evidence pointer after parent-source SHA/CRC/readback; never repeat the original artificial batch blockage or extend the combined eight-request ceiling.
initial_selection_rule: Exactly the returned 6674 latestM17 date2026-09-21, originalM17 date2026-09-18 and delisting-proposalM99 date2026-09-18. Preserve all original index fields and source identity. Reuse prior 6674/2324 M11 originals by hash rather than requesting again.
route_rule: Only exact official HTTPS URLs/pointers demonstrated in saved official responses. Remaining slots may retrieve actual attachments, declared official issuer/IR public pages, or the already returned 6674 conference notice if it addresses a specific contract gap. Preserve each parent archive/member/SHA and exact pointer, freeze hosts/requests individually. No guessed domain/API/PDF name or automatic external-link execution.
required_evidence: 6674 ordinary public-shareholder cash beneficiary and actual current tradability/rights-acquisition window; issuer-side and target-side announcements belong to one deal.
Controlling cash consideration and every adjustment/revision; 18.50 TWD from the Q3 source remains a sourced provisional term until current versions reconcile.
Outstanding shareholder/regulatory conditions, contract closing/termination/long-stop conditions, and exact evidence of satisfied versus still-pending approvals.
Entitlement, last-trading/book-closure/record-date mechanics; final or explicitly provisional conversion trigger and the applicable business-day payment rule/calendar.
Legal transaction form, relevant tax/withholding and fee rules; self-funding is a statement, not guaranteed payment or credit safety.
qualification_meaning: A fully described conditional contractual claim may be analyzed before future approval or actual payment. A future bank receipt is not required to start current research. Unseen critical contract terms remain unknown rather than assumed absent.
on_terms_qualified: Continue offline to a single-deal contractual clock and integer-share cash ledger with meaningful synthetic tests. Freeze any later valuation separately; this phase makes no quote requests or return calculations.
on_cancel_or_no_public_cash_right: Close the executable path for this deal with the controlling evidence; retain the project-level frontier and do not transform internal cancellations into failed public cash exits.
on_budget_or_material_evidence_gap: At six new requests/eight combined, retain exact missing contract/current-rights evidence and all failed responses. Stop acquisition without retries, arbitrary further search, new budget or manual user downloads. Do not infer a missing public contract before inspecting demonstrated issuer-public pointers within the remaining slots.
prospective_rule: Historical PIT completeness is not required for this current qualification, but no valid prospective signal until all necessary current inputs are reconciled and sealed before the chosen future entry cutoff. Missed dates remain gaps.
